$comment: What the menu mod relies on in the sim (see Contracts in docs/development.md), read by the app's compatibility check. Owned by the mod: a change that adds a dependency on the sim updates this file in the same commit. liveChecks[].run is an ES2017 function evaluated in the mainUi page; it receives ctx = { store, engineUi, utils, flight, aircraft } and returns { ok, detail } (or a promise of it).

options.label: Show the white dot cursor in freelook (re-validated to save the profile)

componentPatterns.label: LeftBlock (width) and RightBlock (left) as "* Npx / 1080"
componentPatterns.failure: unexpected format: the left column cannot be widened

liveChecks.label: ResourcesManager.createElementFromGuid
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ({ ok: !!window.ResourcesManager && typeof window.ResourcesManager.createElementFromGuid === 'function' })

liveChecks.label: trait "selectable" in GuidToTrait
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => { let found = false; ctx.engineUi.GuidToTrait.forEach((trait) => { if (trait && trait.traitName === 'selectable') found = true; }); return { ok: found }; }

liveChecks.label: UITimeline.prototype.add / addEvent
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ({ ok: !!ctx.engineUi.UITimeline && typeof ctx.engineUi.UITimeline.prototype.add === 'function' && typeof ctx.engineUi.UITimeline.prototype.addEvent === 'function' })

liveChecks.label: UITransition.prototype.getTransitionStr
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ({ ok: !!ctx.engineUi.UITransition && typeof ctx.engineUi.UITransition.prototype.getTransitionStr === 'function' })

liveChecks.label: UniversalProxy, RegisterViewListener
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ({ ok: typeof ctx.utils.UniversalProxy === 'function' && typeof ctx.utils.RegisterViewListener === 'function' })

liveChecks.label: Game.Aircraft.CurrentAircraft
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.aircraft.CurrentAircraft().then((v) => ({ ok: !!(v && v.variationId && v.displayName), detail: v ? v.displayName + ' / ' + v.variation : 'empty' }))

liveChecks.label: Game.Aircraft.AircraftList
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.aircraft.AircraftList.requestRange(0, 1000).then((n) => ({ ok: typeof n === 'number', detail: n ? n + ' aircraft in the tab' : 'empty (normal outside aircraft selection)' }))

liveChecks.label: Game.Options.General: the option re-validated to save the profile
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => { const general = ctx.store.Game.Options.General; const section = 'MENU_OPTIONS_FLIGHT_INTERFACE'; const wanted = 'OptionsGeneralItemGUID_{666BFED5-26A0-4C7D-BF27-D717AFCAF33D}'; const node = general.Item[section]; return general.UpdateSectionOptionsGeneral.request(section).then(() => node.requestRange(0, 1000)).then((n) => { const reads = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) reads.push(node.getElement(i)); return Promise.all(reads); }).then((items) => { const item = items.filter((x) => x && x.strID === wanted)[0]; if (!item) return { ok: false, detail: 'option not found: the mod data is not saved to the disk' }; let walk = ctx.store; item.dataRoute.split('/').forEach((part) => { walk = walk[part]; }); return walk().then((d) => ({ ok: !!d && typeof d.iDefault === 'number' && d.strId === wanted, detail: d ? (d.sTitle || '') + ' = ' + d.iDefault : 'unreadable' })); }); }

liveChecks.label: Game.Aircraft.FilteredCategory
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.aircraft.FilteredCategory().then((v) => ({ ok: true, detail: v === undefined || v === null || v === '' ? 'empty (normal outside aircraft selection)' : String(v) }))

liveChecks.label: Game.Aircraft.Configurator.Details
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.aircraft.Configurator.Details().then((v) => ({ ok: true, detail: v && v.variationId ? 'on ' + v.variationId : 'released (normal outside aircraft selection)' }))

liveChecks.label: Game.Aircraft.CurrentIdentification (Tail number)
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.aircraft.UpdateCurrentAircraftIdentification.request().then(() => ctx.aircraft.CurrentIdentification()).then((v) => { const field = v && v.identificationInfos && v.identificationInfos.find((i) => i.dataName === 'TT:MENU.AIRCRAFT.TAIL_NUMBER'); return { ok: !!field, detail: field ? field.value + ', at most ' + field.allowedLength + ' characters' : 'field missing' }; })

liveChecks.label: GameFlight.timeData
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.timeData().then((v) => ({ ok: !!(v && v.localTime && typeof v.localTime.value === 'number'), detail: v && v.localTime ? v.localTime.valueStr : 'empty' }))

liveChecks.label: GameFlight.weatherIndex
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.weatherIndex().then((v) => ({ ok: typeof v === 'number' }))

liveChecks.label: GameFlight.isUsingLiveTimeBuffer
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.isUsingLiveTimeBuffer().then((v) => ({ ok: typeof v === 'boolean' }))

liveChecks.label: GameFlight.liveTimeOffset
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.liveTimeOffset().then((v) => ({ ok: typeof v === 'number' }))

liveChecks.label: GameFlight.departure
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.departure().then((v) => ({ ok: v !== undefined, detail: v && v.worldLocation ? v.worldLocation.iCAO || 'no ICAO' : 'no departure' }))

liveChecks.label: Game.Weather.FlightConditions.PresetList
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => { const list = ctx.store.Game.Weather.FlightConditions.PresetList; return list.requestRange(0, 1000).then((n) => list.getElement(0).then((p) => ({ ok: n > 0 && !!p && !!p.iconUrl && !!p.title, detail: n + ' presets' }))); }

liveChecks.label: Elements.FlightConditions.InteractionBlocked
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.store.Elements.FlightConditions.InteractionBlocked().then((v) => ({ ok: typeof v === 'boolean' }))

liveChecks.label: GameFlight.isLiveWeather
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.isLiveWeather().then((v) => ({ ok: typeof v === 'boolean' }))

liveChecks.label: Game.CurrentFlight.FlightConditions (traffic, multiplayer)
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.store.Game.CurrentFlight.UpdateFlightConditions.request('').then(() => ctx.store.Game.CurrentFlight.FlightConditions()).then((v) => { const ids = (g) => (v && v[g] ? v[g].map((b) => b.id) : []); const has = (g, wanted) => wanted.every((id) => ids(g).indexOf(id) >= 0); const ok = has('airtraffic', ['AIRTRAFFICLIVE', 'AIRTRAFFICAI', 'AIRTRAFFICOFF']) && has('multiplayer', ['MULTIPLAYERLIVE', 'MULTIPLAYERALL', 'MULTIPLAYEROFF']); return { ok: ok, detail: ok ? ids('airtraffic').concat(ids('multiplayer')).join(', ') : 'unexpected buttons' }; })

liveChecks.label: Game.Aircraft.GetAircraftSortingOptions
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.aircraft.GetAircraftSortingOptions.request('').then((v) => ({ ok: Array.isArray(v) && v.length > 0, detail: Array.isArray(v) ? v.length + ' options' : 'empty' }))

liveChecks.label: Game.Weather.GetWeatherFromMetarAtLocation (departure)
liveChecks.run: (ctx) => ctx.flight.departure().then((d) => { if (!d || !d.id) return { ok: true, detail: 'no departure (normal)' }; const icao = (d.worldLocation && d.worldLocation.iCAO) || 'departure ' + d.id; return ctx.store.Game.Weather.GetWeatherFromMetarAtLocation.request(String(d.id)).then((w) => (w ? { ok: w.windSpeed !== undefined, detail: icao + ' ' + (w.flightRules || 'no category') } : { ok: true, detail: icao + ': no METAR' })); })
